summary: Exposes a POP input connector on the parent component and brings that parent input into the internal POP network. If the parent input is unconnected, it can pass through data from its second input as a default fallback.

key_params.name: label
key_params.note: Hover label shown on the parent component input connector

key_params.name: connectorder
key_params.note: Sort key for ordering parent component input connectors

key_concepts: One In POP creates one parent input connector
Second input supplies default data when the parent input is unconnected
Connect Order sorts component input connectors
common_gotchas: Each In POP creates one parent input connector, so duplicate or stale In POPs alter a component's public interface.
Use the second input as an explicit default-data fallback for reusable components that must cook when nothing is connected.
Keep connectorder stable in generated components so user wiring does not jump around between revisions.
